svg.title: Pacific South Subsurface Countercurrent: OSW editorial reference-route candidate
svg.desc: Equirectangular schematic. Approximately 5000 km. Declared historical southern mean-core studied reach from 155 W 3.5 S to 110 W 5.5 S. These gates truncate the larger southern subsurface flow. Western formation, secondary-jet geometry and eastern continuation are excluded. This is one study-defined connection, not an aggregate centerline or sum of primary and secondary branches. Source describes regional geography; OSW selects the drawn route. No measured current axis.
svg.text: OSW approximate 155 W to 110 W historical southern mean-core reach — candidate
Dashed: nominal route · pale: 81 editorial scenarios
Not an observed axis or statistical confidence interval
Source: Johnson & Moore (1997); OSW selects vertices
Equirectangular OSW atlas ground · scientific review pending
